candidates.rationale: The self-supplied manifest key no longer establishes trust. A caller argument or explicit environment configuration must pin the same raw Ed25519 key, and the v2 signature commits every manifest field except the signature value itself. Independently constructed signatures pass only with the external pin; foreign/absent pins, old root-only signatures, nested/unknown-field changes and altered owned-ledger data reject. Authentication without a database is explicitly limited to the signed manifest.

Optional ledger recomputes root and count. Hardware remains NOT_VERIFIED and require_hardware prevents overall success; verification_scope distinguishes manifest-only from manifest-and-ledger.
